knowledge_base: Swedish VVS drawing conventions, symbols and designations
language_policy: English glosses and explanations; Swedish codes (beteckningar) and Swedish terms preserved verbatim. Industry terms (VVS, ritning, mängdavtagning, systembeteckning, isometri) are not translated.
source_type: Swedish VVS trade handbook chapter: 'Ritningar och beskrivningar' (drawings and specifications)

standards_referenced.scope: Swedish standard for drawing symbols on VVS-ritningar
standards_referenced.note: Deviates somewhat from the European standard.

standards_referenced.scope: Swedish framework for how ritningar and beskrivningar are produced and structured.
Reference work that tekniska beskrivningar link to via codes and headings.
standards_referenced.note: A code plus its heading in the beskrivning invokes both the text under that heading in AMA and the text of superordinate headings, per the so-called pyramidregeln (pyramid rule).

standards_referenced.scope: Swedish classification system used together with BIP (Building Information Properties) for systematic designations and properties.
Building Information Properties. BIP QTO allows quantities to be extracted, sorted and summed for other systems.

caveat: Beyond the standards there is industry praxis that can differ case by case, depending on the routines of the individual consultant (konsult) and client (byggherre). Any automated interpretation of a ritning must tolerate deviations from the tables in this knowledge base.
